messages:
maya: heads up — I'm sketching a console preview for the v1 sunset that shows per-tenant impact (quota delta + latency band). want quick feedback before i wire telemetry.
nate: nice. what's the UX goal? a banner + explainer or a per-route impact modal?
maya: per-route modal with an estimated "migration risk" score + a simulated traffic split to show quota/latency changes. also a timeframe selector (7/30/90d) so PMs can see short vs long term.
eli: simulation needs to be conservative. we should apply a 'cold-start' multiplier for replicas that will be spun up when clients flip to v2. otherwise numbers look too optimistic.
maya: agreed. idea: baseline = current v1 traffic, then two projections: optimistic (prefetch/caching preserved) and conservative (cache miss + smaller batch gains).
sam: telemetry question: do we have a safe way to surface per-tenant token delta without leaking absolute volumes? we can surface percent change and an example request distribution instead.
eli: percent + bucketed ranges (0-10k, 10k-100k, 100k+) should be fine. don't show raw token counts unless tenant opted in.
console-bot: flag rollouts:deprecation-preview enabled for 20% orgs. To opt-in, add tag `deprecation-preview: true` on org settings. See /help/flags
maya: proto UI mock: ```
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "current_latency_p50": "120ms",
  "proj_conservative_p50": "160ms",
  "proj_optimistic_p50": "130ms",
  "quota_delta": "+12% (estimate)",
  "migration_risk": "medium"
}
```
nate: can we include fallback-policy cost impact? i.e. if runtime routes to v1-fallback in peak, what's extra cost per 1M tokens.
maya: yes — add a secondary line: "fallback_cost_est": "$120 / 1M tokens (worst-case)". that is based on dedicated fallback multiplier x1.6.
eli: on sampling: when computing migration_risk, sample only requests that include user-supplied system messages or long seq lengths — those are the ones that differ most between v1/v2.
sam: also add a short CTA in modal: "Request deeper audit" which creates an internal ticket with a link to sampled traces (redact PII).
maya: last thing — UX copy shouldn't say "sunset" right away. use "migration window" + explicit dates. legal will want one more pass.
nate: sounds good. i'll validate the math with billing team tomorrow and sync on the fallback multiplier.
maya: cool — i'll push a tiny MVP to the flag group and capture feedback. thanks all :thumbsup:
thread_summary: short UX+telemetry convo about console preview for v1 deprecation: projections, safe telemetry exposure, sampling heuristics, and rollout flag
